dedupe_keys.name: tdx hydro global high resolution stream networks and drainage basins from 12 m tandem x nga

description: TDX-Hydro is a global hydrographic data suite of stream networks, drainage basins and hydrologically conditioned elevation derived from 12 m TanDEM-X elevation data, developed by the NGA Office of Geomatics and first released publicly in 2023. The conditioning applies vegetation bias removal (using Landsat tree cover, forest canopy height and ICESat-2), adaptive smoothing, river enforcement with OpenStreetMap and surface water occurrence, and depression handling, run on the Blue Waters supercomputer before TauDEM delineation. Coverage: global land, processed per HydroBASINS level 2 basin (for example Africa 1020000010 and Europe 2020000010) with a 1 km buffer; outputs are vector stream networks, catchments for each stream segment, flow direction and accumulation rasters, and endorheic sink points. Format and access: GeoPackage files named by dataset, HydroBASINS ID and version, downloadable per basin from the Geosciences tab of earth-info.nga.mil, with a technical document (last edited 31 January 2023) and a licence file; free. Licence: CC-BY-SA-4.0, copyright 2023 NGA, for commercial and non-commercial use. Caveats: the conditioned 12 m DEM itself is limited distribution and not public; reservoir flattening can move water-level jumps upstream; HydroBASINS boundaries do not match TanDEM-X exactly, so some streams are truncated at basin edges; coastal masking lets streams extend slightly past the coast. Simulation uses: river network topology and catchments for flood hazard exposure, drainage and dam studies, and hydrologic model set-up at global scale. Related records: HydroSHEDS (data-hydrosheds-hydrorivers-hydrobasins) provides the HydroBASINS tiling that TDX-Hydro is organised by.
